name: Pokémon: Super Cool Spot Version
storyline: Set briefly after the events of Pokémon: Emerald version, SUPER Cool Spot version follows the battle between you, Team Coke, and Team Pepsi, who seek to destroy 7-Up and force the innocent people to drink cola! All the while, strange things have been happening at the Pokémon League in Ever Grande City, and it's up to you to save Hoenn and more importantly, 7-Up! Search the region for all 7 ancient Cool Balls and Meet a new set of Gym Leaders, new Elite Four, all with altered teams and an increased difficulty!
summary: SUPER Cool Spot version features over 80 brand-new Pokémon and regional, 7-Up themed variants, including the one and only Cool Spot! There are 386 unique Pokémon to catch across the Hoenn region with a whole new distribution unique from the original game, and all 386 are obtainable in a single playthrough! New unique attacks are also introduced, such as Mandibite, a new, powerful Bug-type attack, and the devastating 7-Up Beam!
